evaluation_instructions: Run each prompt independently with SKILL.md. Planning must separate Epic context from Sprint membership, preview live writes, and keep Story delivery stations unchanged.

evals.name: epic-to-future-sprint-preview
evals.prompt: 請幫我規劃 Epic PROJ-EPIC-12 的下一個 Sprint。Board 是 42，Sprint 叫做 2026-11 Sprint 3，日期是 2026-11-16 到 2026-11-27，目標是完成 CSV 匯出。候選 Story 是 PROJ-101、PROJ-102、PROJ-103。先預覽，不要寫入 Jira。
evals.expected_output: Produce a dry-run planning result with the board, Epic context, Future Sprint payload, candidate issue list, and no claim that Jira was changed.
assertions: Keeps Epic as planning context and treats the named Stories as Sprint candidates.
Shows Sprint name, dates, goal, board id, and dry_run true.
Does not route into team-dev or claim that Jira was mutated.

evals.name: apply-after-preview
evals.prompt: 預覽已確認。請把 PROJ-201、PROJ-202 放進現有 Jira Sprint 881，現在可以套用。請說明會執行什麼以及完成條件。
evals.expected_output: Use team-plan commit behavior, apply only after explicit confirmation, target Sprint 881, and report the exact moved keys as the completion condition.
assertions: Targets the existing Sprint 881 instead of creating a duplicate Sprint.
Applies only the named Story keys and reports exact moved keys.
Does not change Story review, QA, or release state.

evals.name: sprint-status-and-routing
evals.prompt: 請查看目前 Scrum Board 42 的 Future 和 Active Sprint，並告訴我 PROJ-301 下一步要進哪個 Skill。不要修改 Jira。
evals.expected_output: Read Sprint status, leave Jira unchanged, and route PROJ-301 to the appropriate Story skill only after planning context is clear.
assertions: Uses read-only status behavior and states that Jira was not changed.
Shows Sprint state or asks for the missing board/Sprint choice without guessing.
Routes Story work to team-spec or the existing delivery station, not to team-plan indefinitely.
